clauses.label: sole paragraph
clauses.text:
)Erecutive et
Wilbur J. Keblinger, of Virginia, formerly Commissioner for the
United States on the Rio Grande and the Colorado River Commissions,
and until recently and for more than fourteen years Secretary of the Inter-
national Boundary Commission, may be appointed to a post in the consular
service without regard to the Executive Order of June 27, 1906.
